subject: Novum Health: launch play, point people & pre-launch risks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Hale <sara.hale@novumhealth.com>, Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@novumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Novum Health: launch play, point people & pre-launch risks

Tessa / Ben —

Quick handoff note as we move this to post-sign: Novum signed yesterday EOD. Contract and DS currently routing; Sara & Miguel looped above will be primary on their side. High-level ask: we need a short, practical launch play and an internal owner list that covers (a) tech intake + test data, (b) security questionnaire follow-up, (c) go-live validation checks for first pilot.

Key deal facts (short):
- ARR band: mid-six figures (annualized)
- Primary model usage: hosted text-generation for triage + embeddings for semantic search
- Data plane: customer will use regional VPC; they require KMS integration and 90-day KV cache retention (negotiated in SOW)
- Target go-live window: pilot by 2026-10-18 (client expects a 6-week run from kickoff)

Immediate asks to Sales->CS: please own the following items and confirm owners by EOD tomorrow: 
1) Technical intake (env, sample payloads, perf SLOs to simulate) — owner
2) Security/compliance follow-ups (SOC 2 artifacts, KMS questions) — owner
3) Mutual Action Plan (we gave them MAP v1; attach v2 below with suggested sprint breakdown) — owner
4) Kickoff meeting scheduling + runbook for sprint0 (who will speak to infra/resourcing) — owner

Attachments: Novum_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx (draft timeline), Novum_Onboarding_Sprint0_checklist.pdf

Risks to call out on first pass:
- KMS/HSM approval could add 2-week procurement delay if they need vendor-side vetting
- They expect sub-200ms p50 for short queries in their pilot; we should validate model selection/quantization early
- Procurement has requested a single-tenant commitment on the SOW; if Procurement pushes, we may need legal to confirm acceptance language

Ben — I know you own the SOW handoffs. Can you confirm procurement contact and whether legal already approved the single-tenant wording? Tessa — can you pick the tech intake owner and I'll introduce them to Miguel for sample payloads?

Thanks —
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Hale <sara.hale@novumhealth.com>, Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@novumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novum Health: launch play, point people & pre-launch risks

On Tue, Sep 1, 2026 at 3:04 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — I know you own the SOW handoffs. Can you confirm procurement contact and whether legal already approved the single-tenant wording?

Quick update: procurement@novumhealth.com is the contact (copied). Legal greenlit the single-tenant paragraph in principle but requested the final appendix that spells out isolation controls. I asked legal to draft appendix language and looped them into the DocuSign envelope — should be ready for review by 2026-09-06.

I'll own procurement coordination and the DocuSign flow (procurement + legal + client). I'll also ping Contracts to confirm the appendix header and any special audit requirements.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0222
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Hale <sara.hale@novumhealth.com>, Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@novumhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novum Health: launch play, point people & pre-launch risks

Thanks for the context, Jonas.

I will own the technical intake & sprint0 runbook. Proposed internal owners (tentative):
- Tech intake & infra validation: Priya Natarajan (I will assign and intro)
- Security/compliance follow-up: Monica Patel (will coordinate SOC 2 artifacts and KMS details)
- Pilot go-live validation + monitoring: Marcus Lin (will prepare acceptance checks and tracing hooks)

Next steps from CS side:
1) I will schedule a 60-minute kickoff for 2026-09-10 (client available mornings PST) — agenda: goals, success metrics, data flow, sprint0 timeline, and integration owners.
2) Priya will reach out to Miguel for sample payloads and environment details by 2026-09-03.
3) Monica to request the Nagios/third-party audit report if client can share — if not, we will provide SOC 2 scoping docs and KMS architecture notes.

I'll add the MAP v2 timeline into a CS-friendly 4-week sprint0 plan and drop it into the shared HubSpot record. Ben — can you confirm the expected signature date so we can align sprint0 start?

-Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com | +1 408-555-0180
From: Sara Hale <sara.hale@novumhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@novumhealth.com>, procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novum Health: launch play, point people & pre-launch risks

Thanks Jonas — and thanks Tessa & Ben for the quick responses. Helpful to see owners up front. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement wants to finish DocuSign by 2026-09-07; Miguel is coordinating with legal and procurement@novumhealth.com.
- For KMS: we will provide the list of approved KMS vendors by Friday; if Redwood can accept those vendors in the appendix, that would be ideal.
- Pilot acceptance: Novum wants an initial pilot run with 1,000 test requests/day for 2 weeks and a triage accuracy baseline (>85%) before scaling. Miguel will share sample payloads by 2026-09-03 EOD.

We appreciate the clarity on owners. Looking forward to the kickoff on 2026-09-10.

Sara Hale
Director of Product Operations | Novum Health
sara.hale@novumhealth.com | +1 212-555-0133

Attachment references: Novum_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx (we reviewed and propose small timing tweaks to week 2), Novum_Onboarding_Sprint0_checklist.pdf
